description: This Perl script implements a sample Git filter protocol version 2 handler. It handles the initialization handshake, capabilities exchange, and processes filter commands ('clean' and 'smudge') by reading and writing packets over standard input and output. The script serves as a minimal skeleton providing the basic structure for a Git filter driver without full error handling.

methods.name: packet_bin_read
methods.description: Reads a binary packet from STDIN, returning a status indicator and data buffer.

methods.name: packet_txt_read
methods.description: Reads a text packet terminated with LF, using packet_bin_read internally.

methods.name: packet_bin_write
methods.description: Writes a binary packet to STDOUT, prefixed with its length.

methods.name: packet_txt_write
methods.description: Writes a text packet terminated with LF, using packet_bin_write internally.

methods.name: packet_flush
methods.description: Flushes the output buffer by sending a zero-length packet.
